title: ML Model Management System
oneLiner: A customized, authenticated MLflow server with browser-direct artifact uploads and automated deployment.
objective: Customize and run an MLflow server from source with authentication and purpose-built APIs for browser-based artifact uploads and model registration - an end-to-end ML lifecycle system for training, validation, versioning, and deployment across AI projects.
achievements: Built an end-to-end ML lifecycle system on MLflow enabling reproducible training, validation, versioning and deployment.
Created custom triggers for automatic deployment of validated models to production via GitHub Actions + cloud storage.
Containerized the MLflow service in Docker for portable, reproducible environments.
Implemented Flask blueprint endpoints for direct-to-storage uploads (presigned PUT, S3 multipart, GCS resumable) to bypass server bottlenecks.
Integrated endpoints with MLflow auth for RBAC and JWT-authenticated upload flows.
Deployed on Google Cloud with a GCS bucket as the artifact backend.
